items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I knew Sammy very well. So we drove to Vegas... Sammy and I talked... Sammy said, 'Alright Gerald.'

ctx.x: Was this with the Will Mastin trio?

Yes, the Will Mastin trio. That’s right. So I knew Sammy very well. So we drove to Vegas, we went to the sands, and I got through the door and I said, “We’re here to see Sammy Davis.” So the guy was very nice – Jack Entratter’s reputation was a nice man about those kinds of things. He took me on back to Sammy’s room, Sammy and I talked, I said, “Sammy, look. The NAACP is depending on you to be there for this thing. Don’t let them down.” Sammy said, “Alright Gerald.” I said, “Okay.” So we went on back – we went on…
